note.text:
S: Client reported 2 panic attacks this week, down from 4 last week. Client stated, "I made it to class three days and only left early once." Client wants to work on riding the subway alone.
O: Client arrived on time, casually dressed, good eye contact. Affect anxious at start, brighter by end of session. Speech normal rate. Thought process linear. Denies SI/HI.
A: Client is making measurable progress toward Goal 1 (panic attacks 4/week to 2/week) and Goal 2 (class attendance 3 days/week). Client engaged in interoceptive exposure (spinning, 3 trials) and rated peak anxiety 7/10 dropping to 3/10, showing improved tolerance. Continued panic symptoms and avoidance still limit daily functioning, supporting continued weekly treatment.
P: Continue weekly CBT for panic. Client will practice breathing retraining daily and log attacks. Begin subway exposure hierarchy next session. Next session 11/16/2026 10:00 AM.
